---
title: "xuseq"
---

## Description

Create SEQ variable.

## Parameters

**`inds`**

: Name of the input dataset

  *Required:* Yes

**`sortvars`**

: Sort order for the dataset

  *Required:* Yes

**`prefix`**

: Prefix for the SEQ variable name

  *Required:* No

**`debug`**

: Flag that determines whether to delete temporary variables or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%xuseq(dm,usubjid);
%xuseq(adlb,usubjidparamcdadtadtm,prefix=a);
```
